Where is your funnel leaking?

Five rates stand between an impression and a paid order. Move them and watch the ROAS move, then try changing the spend, and watch it not.

A number is not a verdict. Nothing here is a judgement on your brand. It shows you the shape of the problem and the order worth fixing it in, so the next quarter starts prepared instead of surprised.

Questions this calculator answers

What is a good ROAS for a D2C brand in India?

There is no universal number. A good ROAS is any figure above your break-even ROAS, which depends on your COGS, shipping, gateway fees and RTO rate. Brands with 30% COGS and low returns can be profitable at 2.2x, while brands with 55% COGS and 25% RTO may need 4.5x or more.

Does increasing ad spend improve ROAS?

No. Spend determines how many orders you get, not how efficiently you get them. ROAS is set by your CPM, your AOV and the five conversion rates between an impression and a paid order. Doubling spend roughly doubles orders at the same ROAS.

Which funnel step should I fix first?

Usually the one furthest from the benchmark, weighted by traffic volume. Landing-page-to-cart is typically the most expensive step to get wrong because every visitor has already been paid for by that point.
